---
title: apps.yaml
guide-section: Use it
---

One top-level entry per app.

```yaml
bedroom_sunrise:
  module: sunrise_fade
  class: SunriseFade
  light: light.bedroom_lamp

living_room_sunset:
  module: sunset_fade
  class: SunsetFade
  light: light.living_room_lamp
  max_brightness: 30
```

## Entry

| Line | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `bedroom_sunrise:` | App name. You choose it. |
| `module`, `class` | Which app. From the app's page, or the table below. |
| Other lines | Settings. Listed on the app's page. |

| App | Module | Class |
|---|---|---|
| [Sunrise Fade](../docs/apps/sunrise-fade.qmd) | `sunrise_fade` | `SunriseFade` |
| [Sunset Fade](../docs/apps/sunset-fade.qmd) | `sunset_fade` | `SunsetFade` |
| [Light Fade](../docs/apps/light-fade.qmd) | `light_fade` | `LightFadeApp` |

## Names

- Unique.
- Lowercase letters, digits, `_`.
- Start of every log line for the app.
- Test event: `<name>_start`, e.g. `bedroom_sunrise_start`.

## Rules

| Rule | Example |
|---|---|
| Indent settings two spaces | `  light: light.bedroom_lamp` |
| Quote times. Unquoted, some read as numbers and the app does not load. | `"05:45:00"` |
| Unknown settings are an error | A typo stops the app loading |
| Leave a setting out for its default | |
| `null` clears a default | `off_level: null` |

## Settings for any app

| Setting | Effect |
|---|---|
| `disable: true` | App off. Remove the line to turn it back on. |
| `log_level: DEBUG` | More detail in the log |

## Same app, several times

One entry per use, each with its own name:

```yaml
living_room_sunset:
  module: sunset_fade
  class: SunsetFade
  light: light.living_room_lamp

hallway_sunset:
  module: sunset_fade
  class: SunsetFade
  light: light.hallway
  max_brightness: 20
```

To control several devices as one, make a group (**Settings > Devices & services > Helpers > Create helper > Group**), then use the group's entity ID.

## Changes

- Edit `apps.yaml`, push to `main`. The deploy restarts AppDaemon.
- Edits on the Home Assistant box: overwritten on the next deploy.
- Other files in AppDaemon's `apps` folder: deleted on the next deploy.
